_doc: Reusable simulation model types (implemented in src/sim/parts.js). A part card's 'sim' is a list of model instances: {model, pins: {terminal: card pin key | {role: <pin role>}}, params, io: {rule key: native key | {key, requires_option}}}. Rule keys are what behaviour rules set/check; their direction, type and default come from the model's native keys. Terminals marked optional may be left unwired. A new part that behaves like an existing type needs only a card in parts.json; a new type needs code in parts.js and an entry here.

load.doc: Anything one output pin drives: LED, buzzer, relay, laser, vibration motor module. 'state' is true while the pin spends more than 'threshold' of its time at the active level; 'level' is that fraction (PWM duty). An undriven (input) pin counts as inactive.

contact.doc: A passive switch between the pin and GND (push button, tilt switch, reed switch, joystick click). Closed reads LOW; open reads HIGH only if the firmware enabled the pull-up, otherwise the floating pin reads LOW, so a missing INPUT_PULLUP fails the test.

driven_digital.doc: A module that drives its own HIGH/LOW output (PIR, IR obstacle, touch, flame). Optional 'analog' terminal: the module's analog output, at analog_active / analog_idle ADC counts.

analog_source.doc: A 0-5 V signal (potentiometer, LDR divider, sound/soil/gas sensor analog output). Optional 'digital' terminal: an on-board comparator output that is at digital_active_level while the reading is above (or below) digital_threshold.

servo_pulse.doc: Hobby servo: reads the 50 Hz pulse (min_us..max_us = 0..max_angle) and turns at deg_per_s; holds position when pulses stop.

ultrasonic.doc: Trigger/echo ranger (HC-SR04 style): after a trigger pulse of at least min_trigger_us, echo goes high delay_us later for distance * us_per_cm; beyond max_cm it returns a no_echo_us pulse.

dht.doc: DHT-family single-wire temperature/humidity sensor. encoding 'int' (DHT11: whole-number bytes) or 'tenths' (DHT22/AM2302: 16-bit tenths, sign bit). Responds after the line is held low for at least start_low_us.

imu_mpu6050.doc: MPU6050-compatible I2C IMU register map. Attitude moves to the set pitch/roll at deg_per_s; accelerometer reports gravity, gyro reports the rotation rate. roll = rotation about X, pitch = about Y.

ssd1306.doc: SSD1306-compatible I2C OLED. Decodes commands into display RAM and reads text back in 5x7 fonts (1x and 2x). Text counts only while the display and charge pump are on.

hd44780_i2c.doc: HD44780 character LCD behind a PCF8574 I2C backpack, 4-bit mode. bits: which expander bit is RS/RW/EN/backlight/D4 (D4-D7 consecutive).
